title: Bharat Realty — Real Estate Marketplace Frontend

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign-in/out UI and authenticated user association in the frontend (principal-aware UX + profile setup).
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity
After sign-in, the UI shows the signed-in state (e.g., short principal / account menu)
Backend can identify the caller Principal for create/update actions and rejects unauthenticated calls where required

file_operations.description: Create the app shell (layout + routing) and wire authentication state into navigation (signed-in vs signed-out). Use the authorization component guidance to drive login/logout UX and profile setup gating. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a login/logout button using useInternetIdentity and clear React Query cache on logout to remove cached app data. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a first-login modal that calls getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile to store a display name (avoid showing raw principal in the UI). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a React Query hook for getCallerUserProfile with loading semantics that avoid modal flash (actor dependency-aware), per authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a header with brand, primary navigation, and authenticated user area (name/account menu + AuthButton). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement seller listing create/edit/delete UI and wire it to backend listing capabilities; show public read-only listing views.
acceptanceCriteria: Seller can create a listing after authentication
Seller can edit and delete only their own listings
Listings store and return: title, listing type (Land/Home), description, quoted price (numeric), currency=INR, basic location text (e.g., city/area), createdAt/updatedAt
Public listing feed and listing detail can be fetched without needing seller permissions

file_operations.description: Create the “My Listings” dashboard page to fetch the signed-in seller’s listings and provide navigation to create/edit flows; ensure it is guarded behind authentication. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create listing edit page that loads listing data and allows owner to update fields (title/type/category/description/INR price/location/status) using backend functions; disable/guard edit UI for non-owners. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create listing creation page with a form to create a Land/Home listing in INR and then optionally proceed to image upload step. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a reusable listing form component for create/edit with validation and INR-only currency selection (hidden/fixed to INR in UI). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks for listing feed (fetchRandomListings) and seller listings (getListingsBySeller), including cache keys and loading/error states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a React Query hook for getListing(listingId) to support listing detail and edit flows. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Support multiple listing image upload and display with a gallery/carousel and placeholder handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Seller can upload at least 1 image for a listing and see it displayed on the listing detail page
A listing can have multiple images and the UI lets users browse them (gallery/grid and/or carousel)
Backend validates that only the listing owner can attach images to their listing
If a listing has no images, the UI shows a consistent placeholder image

file_operations.description: Create a multi-file image picker/uploader that converts selected files to ExternalBlob (blob-storage) and calls uploadListingImages; show upload progress (ExternalBlob.withUploadProgress). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an image gallery/carousel that renders listing images via ExternalBlob.getDirectURL (blob-storage) and falls back to the static placeholder when none exist. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ImageGallery into the listing detail page and show a consistent placeholder image when images are empty. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add an owner-only image management section using ImageUploader for attaching multiple images to the listing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create buyer browsing UI: listing feed with search/filters and listing detail with images, INR price, and CTAs.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can browse a feed of listings
Users can search by keyword (e.g., title/location/description) and filter by type and price range
Listing cards show thumbnail, title, type, and formatted INR price
Listing detail page shows full description, image gallery, and clear CTAs for contact and offer

file_operations.description: Create the home/feed page that fetches listings and provides client-side search (keyword across title/location/description) and filters (type + price range), plus an empty state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create listing card UI with thumbnail (first image direct URL or placeholder), title, type, location, and formatted INR price; link card to listing detail route. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the listing detail page showing gallery, description, location, seller section, formatted INR price, and CTAs for Contact and Make Offer. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register routes for feed and listing detail pages and ensure they are reachable via header navigation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement contact-seller messaging UI for buyers and an inbox for sellers to view messages per listing.
acceptanceCriteria: Buyer can submit a contact message from a listing detail page
Seller can view a list of messages received for their listings (with listing reference, message text, created time, and buyer Principal)
Only the listing owner can view messages for that listing
Backend persists messages and returns them in reverse chronological order

file_operations.description: Create a contact dialog on listing detail that submits a message via sendMessage and includes senderName sourced from the user profile when authenticated. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the seller “Inbox (Messages)” page to list messages for the seller’s listings (grouped/filterable by listing) by calling getMessagesForListing for each owned listing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks to fetch messages per listing (getMessagesForListing) and to submit messages (sendMessage) with cache invalidation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire ContactSellerDialog into the listing detail CTAs and handle unauthenticated submission gracefully (prompt to sign in when required by backend). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register the protected dashboard inbox route and add navigation entry in the dashboard area. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement offer option generation (3 successive 35% reductions), buyer offer submission, and seller offer viewing UI.
acceptanceCriteria: On listing detail, user sees 3 offer options generated from the quoted price using repeated 35% reductions (option1=price*0.65; option2=option1*0.65; option3=option2*0.65)
Offer option amounts are displayed formatted in INR with sensible rounding to whole rupees
Buyer can submit an offer for a specific listing choosing one of the 3 options
Seller can view offers received per listing (amount, option index, buyer Principal, timestamp)
Only authenticated users can submit offers

file_operations.description: Implement deterministic offer option generation from quoted price using repeated 35% reductions and whole-rupee rounding, returning exactly 3 options plus metadata (option index).

Create a dialog on listing detail showing the 3 generated offer options (INR formatted), allowing selection and submission via submitOffer; require authentication (prompt to sign in). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create seller “Offers” dashboard page that lists offers received for the seller’s listings grouped/filterable by listing (requires authenticated access). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add hooks for submitting offers (submitOffer) and fetching offers for a listing (requires a backend capability exposed in types) with cache invalidation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Extend the generated frontend typing to include offer read models and a backend function for fetching offers per listing (to support the seller offers dashboard UI).
Wire MakeOfferDialog into listing detail CTAs and ensure the offer options are derived from the listing quoted price. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register the protected dashboard offers route and add navigation entry in the dashboard area. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Format all prices as INR consistently across the UI (cards, detail, and offers).
acceptanceCriteria: All price displays show INR formatting (₹ and Indian number formatting where applicable)
No other currency symbols are shown anywhere in the listing/offer UI

file_operations.description: Add a single formatting utility for INR display (₹, Indian digit grouping) and safe bigint-to-number/string handling for UI display.
Use the INR formatting utility for quotedPrice display and ensure no other currency symbols appear.
Use the INR formatting utility for quoted price and any derived offer amounts and ensure no other currency symbols appear.
Use the INR formatting utility for all offer option amounts and submitted offer amount display.

requirements.summary: Add seller dashboard pages and protected routing for My Listings, Inbox (Messages), and Offers.
acceptanceCriteria: Signed-in seller can view their listings and navigate to edit/delete
Signed-in seller can view messages and offers grouped or filterable by listing
Dashboard routes are protected behind authentication (prompt to sign in if not authenticated)

file_operations.description: Create a route guard wrapper that requires Internet Identity authentication; show a sign-in prompt/state when unauthenticated and render children when authenticated. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a dashboard layout with sub-navigation for “My Listings”, “Inbox (Messages)”, and “Offers”, designed for responsive use. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire dashboard routes under a protected wrapper (RequireAuth) and ensure navigation from the main header to the dashboard exists. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a modern, premium real-estate visual theme consistently across feed, listing detail, and dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: UI has a consistent theme (color palette, typography scale, and component styling) across pages
Primary actions (Post Listing, Contact, Make Offer) are visually prominent and consistent
Layouts are responsive and usable on mobile and desktop
Theme avoids default/unstyled template look

file_operations.description: Create global Tailwind layers and CSS variables to define a premium theme (typography, spacing, color tokens) used consistently across the app.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions (tokens/typography) to support a premium real-estate look while keeping existing shadcn/tailwind variable-based structure.
Apply consistent layout, spacing, and primary action styling (e.g., Post Listing) aligned with the new theme. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure feed layout, filters, cards, and empty states follow the theme and remain responsive. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure listing detail layout and CTAs (Contact/Offer) follow the theme and remain responsive. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Wire generated brand and placeholder images as frontend static assets and use them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated
UI uses the generated logo in the header/auth area
UI uses the generated placeholder image anywhere a listing lacks uploaded images
UI uses an empty-state illustration for ‘no results’ (optional but present if generated)

file_operations.description: Use the generated brand logo image at frontend/public/assets/generated/realty-logo.dim_512x256.png in the header/auth area.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/property-placeholder.dim_1200x800.png as the thumbnail when a listing has no uploaded images.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/property-placeholder.dim_1200x800.png as the consistent placeholder when the listing image array is empty.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/no-results.dim_900x600.png for the ‘no results’ empty state illustration when filters/search return nothing.
